question: Can nonlinear QuickGELU feature moments for explicit data-free LN/task-SVD probe distributions be computed consistently from model parameters? Not a defense or classification experiment.
radius: sqrt(768);open ball in normalized pre-affine LN coordinates
task_domain: G=diag(gamma)^-1 V_A;N spans null(1^T G);Q=orth(G N). Thus Q is centered and diag(gamma)Q lies in span(V_A). Use complete resulting subspace,not selected directions.
moment_order_scope: Fixed numerical convergence check;not model/defense parameter search
mc_check: Independent full-dimensional normalized Gaussian and U^(1/n) radius;all 9x9 augmented moments;report max deviation and deviations beyond6SE+1e-6,not a rigorous integration certificate
limitations: Neither probe distribution is asserted to be the true task distribution. First8-neuron moment matrices do not establish full3072-unit numerical stability,task accuracy or recovery protection. No optimizer or fit to create a release.
